prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: native app face-cutout QA fixture, not release artwork
Primary request: Generate one color studio headshot of a wholly fictional adult person.
Scene/backdrop: Plain, evenly lit bright blue background with plenty of empty space around the person.
Subject: One adult, approximately 35 years old, looking straight at the camera with a gentle neutral expression. Both eyes and ears visible; clear short hair and ear silhouette. Ordinary dark charcoal crew-neck top. Head, neck, and shoulders visible.
Composition/framing: Portrait photograph. Person centered and occupying the middle 60% of the frame width; entire hair silhouette comfortably inside the image, shoulders visible along the lower portion. Clear separation from backdrop, no objects.
Style/medium: Realistic color studio photography, natural skin texture, crisp focus, even soft lighting.
Constraints: Wholly fictional identity. Exactly one adult. No text, logos, watermarks, hats, glasses, jewelry, extra people or decorative elements. Bright blue background is opaque; do not remove or blur it.
visual_inspection: One fictional adult, front-facing, both ears and hair silhouette visible, shoulders visible, bright blue empty background, no text or branding.
intended_use: Native PhotoPicker and Vision face-cutout QA only. Not bundled in the release application.
